form.label: Status
form.description: Collector health per input and data type: last collection, records written, how far behind, errors, and what reached the index. Collector logs come from index _internal; data from the index entered below (* = all indexes, slower).

search.query: | tstats count where index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:log" by source | rex field=source "cisco_se_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | stats sum(count) as count by input | sort input

index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:log" source="*cisco_se_$input$.log*" ("collected" OR "failed") | rex field=source "cisco_se_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>[A-Z]+) (?<what>collected|failed) (?<data_type>[a-z]+): (?<detail>.*)$$" | where isnotnull(data_type) | rex field=detail "^written (?<written>\d+)" | rex field=detail "behind (?<behind_min>-?[\d.]+) min" | rex field=detail "newest (?<newest_min>-?[\d.]+) min ago" | eval ok_time=if(what=="collected", _time, null()), err=if(what=="failed", detail, null()), err_time=if(what=="failed", _time, null()) | stats latest(_time) as last latest(what) as last_result max(ok_time) as last_ok latest(written) as last_written sum(written) as written_8d latest(behind_min) as behind_min latest(newest_min) as newest_min max(err_time) as err_time latest(err) as last_error by input data_type | eval status=case(last_result=="failed", "FAILED", tonumber(behind_min)>60, "BEHIND", true(), "OK") | eval order=case(data_type=="events", 1, data_type=="audit", 2, data_type=="compromises", 3, data_type=="metrics", 4, data_type=="computers", 5, true(), 6) | sort input order | eval last=strftime(last, "%F %T"), last_ok=strftime(last_ok, "%F %T"), last_error=if(status=="FAILED", last_error, null()) | table input data_type status last last_ok last_written written_8d behind_min newest_min last_error

panel.title: Records written per collection, by data type

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:log" source="*cisco_se_$input$.log*" "collected" | rex "^\S+ \S+ [A-Z]+ collected (?<data_type>[a-z]+): written (?<written>\d+)" | where isnotnull(data_type) | timechart sum(written) by data_type

panel.title: Minutes behind: newest event collected (events) and end of the last window (audit logs)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:log" source="*cisco_se_$input$.log*" "collected" ("behind" OR "newest") | rex field=source "cisco_se_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ [A-Z]+ collected (?<data_type>events|audit): " | rex "behind (?<behind_min>-?[\d.]+) min" | rex "newest (?<newest_min>-?[\d.]+) min ago" | eval series=input . " " . data_type, minutes=coalesce(behind_min, newest_min) | where isnotnull(data_type) | timechart max(minutes) by series

panel.title: Run log: collections, first runs, stops, failures

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:log" source="*cisco_se_$input$.log*" ("collected" OR "failed" OR "run done" OR "run failed" OR "run stopped" OR "first run" OR "run requested" OR "account changed") | rex field=source "cisco_se_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | table _time input log_level message | sort - _time

index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:log" source="*cisco_se_$input$.log*" (WARNING OR ERROR OR CRITICAL) | rex field=source "cisco_se_(?<input>[^/\\\\]+?)\.log(?:\.\d+)?$$" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>DEBUG|INFO|WARNING|ERROR|CRITICAL) (?<message>.*)" | search log_level IN (WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL) | eval pattern=replace(message, "\d+", "N") | stats count latest(_time) as last_seen latest(message) as latest_example by input log_level pattern | sort - last_seen | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%F %T") | table input log_level count last_seen latest_example

panel.title: Indexed records per account and sourcetype (by event time, 1-hour buckets)

search.query: | tstats count where index="$idx$" (sourcetype="cisco:se" OR sourcetype="cisco:se:audit") by _time host sourcetype span=1h | eval series=host . " " . sourcetype | timechart span=1h sum(count) by series

panel.title: How late data arrives (index time minus event time, last 4 hours indexed)

search.query: index="$idx$" (sourcetype="cisco:se" OR sourcetype="cisco:se:audit") _index_earliest=-4h | eval data_type=if(sourcetype=="cisco:se:audit", "audit", coalesce(EndpointDataType, "?")), lag_min=(_indextime-_time)/60 | stats count as records perc50(lag_min) as p50_min perc95(lag_min) as p95_min max(lag_min) as max_min by host data_type | foreach *_min [ eval <<FIELD>>=round(<<FIELD>>, 1) ]

panel.title: Splunk messages about the input (start-up and script errors)

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype=splunkd (component=ExecProcessor OR component=ModularInputs) "cisco_secure_endpoint" log_level!=INFO | eval message=coalesce(event_message, _raw) | table _time host log_level component message | sort - _time

panel.title: Changes made on the Inputs page

search.query: index=_internal sourcetype="cisco:se:ta:webapi" | rex "^\S+ \S+ (?<log_level>[A-Z]+) (?<message>.*)" | table _time host log_level message | sort - _time
